pr_title: release-23.1: cloud/amazon: Fix TestS3BucketDoesNotExist with new bucket name
pr_body:
Backport 1/1 commits from #114659 on behalf of @benbardin.

/cc @cockroachdb/release

----

Fixes: #114626, #114627

To test locally, run something like `./dev test pkg/cloud/amazon/... -f TestS3BucketDoesNotExist -v -- --test_env=HOME`

Release note: None

----

Release justification: test flake fix
pr_comments:
Thanks for opening a [backport](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CRDB/pages/900005932/Backporting+a+change+to+a+release+branch).

Please check the backport criteria before merging:

- [ ] Backports should only be created for [serious
  issues](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/1043235321/Database+Backport+Patch+Policy#Backport-only-for-serious-issues) or test-only changes.
- [ ] Backports should not break backwards-compatibility.
- [ ] Backports should change as little code as possible.
- [ ] Backports should not change on-disk formats or node communication protocols.
- [ ] Backports should not add new functionality (except as defined
  [here](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/1043235321/Database+Backport+Patch+Policy#Backporting-new-functionality-(including-modifications-to-persisted-state-%26-cross-node-RPCs))).
- [ ] Backports **must not** add, edit, or otherwise modify cluster versions; or add version gates.
- [ ] All backports must be reviewed by the owning areas TL _and_ one additional
  TL. For more information as to how that review should be conducted, please consult the [backport
policy](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/1043235321/Database+Backport+Patch+Policy#Getting-your-backport-reviewed).


<details>
  <summary>If your backport adds new functionality, please ensure that the
following additional criteria are satisfied:</summary>

- [ ] There is a high priority need for the functionality that cannot wait until the next release and is difficult to address in another way.
- [ ] The new functionality is additive-only and only runs for clusters which have specifically “opted in” to it (e.g. by a cluster setting).
- [ ] New code is protected by a conditional check that is trivial to verify and ensures that it only runs for opt-in clusters. State changes must be further protected such that nodes running old binaries will not be negatively impacted by the new state (with a mixed version test added).
- [ ] The PM and TL on the team that owns the changed code have signed off that the change obeys the above rules.
- [ ] Your backport must be accompanied by a post to the appropriate Slack
  channel (#db-backports-point-releases or #db-backports-XX-X-release) for awareness and discussion.
</details>

Also, please add a brief release justification to the body of your PR to justify this
backport.
